meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测药物分子怎样结合蛋白质
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在药物研发中需要判断化合物如何结合靶蛋白。
copy.tagline_en: Predict how drug molecules bind to proteins
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on drug discovery and need to see how small molecules bind to a target protein.

howto.what: 它让 Claude 帮你做分子对接:给出蛋白质(PDB 文件或氨基酸序列)和配体(SMILES、SDF、MOL2),产出配体的 3D 结合构象文件和置信度分数,可单个或批量运行,并能汇总分析置信度。它不预测结合亲和力(ΔG、Kd)。
howto.when: 当你提到「对接这个配体」、「预测结合构象」等说法,或要求做虚拟筛选、批量对接多个蛋白-配体对时触发。

say.text: 把这个配体对接到 protein.pdb,输出构象和置信度
say.note: 运行单复合物对接,默认生成 10 个排序构象

say.text: 用 batch_input.csv 批量对接这批复合物
say.note: 走批量流程,结果按置信度排序

say.text: 分析 results/batch/ 的置信度并导出 CSV
say.note: 脚本把构象分为 High/Moderate/Low 并排名

howto.what_en: It lets Claude run molecular docking: give a protein (PDB or sequence) plus a ligand (SMILES, SDF, MOL2) and get 3D binding poses with confidence scores, single or batch, plus summary analysis. It does not predict binding affinity (dG, Kd).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "dock this ligand to a protein" or "predict binding pose", or ask for virtual screening, batch docking of protein-ligand pairs, etc.

say_en.text: Dock this ligand to protein.pdb and report poses with confidence
say_en.note: Runs single-complex docking, 10 ranked poses by default
Processes many complexes; results ranked by confidence

say_en.text: Analyze confidence of results/batch/ and export a CSV
say_en.note: Classifies poses High/Moderate/Low and ranks them
